name: AppShell
description: A layout wrapper that provides a sticky sidebar and main content structure. Commonly used with SideNavigation to create application-level page layouts. The sidebar is hidden on mobile viewports.

notes: The sidebar renders as an <aside> landmark for assistive technology.
On mobile viewports the sidebar is hidden; consider pairing with Drawer for mobile navigation.

sidebar.description: Sidebar content, typically a SideNavigation component.

collapsed.description: Whether the sidebar is in collapsed mode.

do: Use AppShell as the outermost layout wrapper for application pages.
Pass a SideNavigation component as the sidebar prop.
Pair with Drawer on mobile for sidebar access below 768px.
dont: Do not nest AppShell inside another AppShell.
Do not use AppShell for marketing or landing pages that have no sidebar.
